response.justification: Bogdan's resume demonstrates strong software engineering skills and experience in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and performance optimization. However, there is no clear evidence of expertise in AI/ML workload optimization, GPU architecture, or SoC/IP modeling—key requirements for this role. His background in web, mobile, and embedded systems does not align closely enough with the hardware-software co-design and AI accelerator focus of the Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages (TypeScript, D, C++, Java)
Proven track record in performance optimization and system architecture design
Experience with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployment
concerns: No direct experience with AI accelerator hardware or deep-learning workload optimization
Lacks demonstrated expertise in SIMD/MIMD architecture or GPU workload analysis
Education does not meet the required qualifications (Bachelor's without sufficient experience equivalent to PhD/6+ years)
